After landing, our chase crew brings us back to the apple orchard and we celebrate our flight with a champagne toast in the old restored barn. There is no better way

quotes.author: Trevor and Sarah
quotes.text: My husband and I were on the Jupiter flight yesterday evening. We just wanted to let you know what an amazing experience this was and the best way to celebrate our five year anniversary. We were both truly impressed and in awe the entire flight. Breath taking!!! Again I just wanted to Thank you for the great experience and all that you do! I will be referring any family and friends here to you! We're both still all smiles yet this morning even thinking about how great it was and will definitely be back at some point!!!!

quotes.author: Angela & Bill
quotes.text: Thank you all very much for a wonderful balloon flight yesterday. Jim was a great pilot, answering all our questions and pointing things out for us to see, and the crew did a superb job both before and after the flight. It’s obvious that everyone involved loves balloons! The flight was a 50th birthday gift for me and although my birthday was last October, it was well worth waiting for! Keep up the good work and we hope to see you again!

quotes.author: Derek & Jamie
quotes.text: Aamodt’s Balloon Ride Employees, Thank you so much for the wonderful ride! I have attached a few pictures from our flight to remember. We took off as boyfriend and girlfriend and landed as an engaged couple. It was the most beautiful day, we enjoyed the ride and plan on going again on our anniversary. Jim was an amazing pilot and he answered all of our questions. This was the most amazing day of our lives! Thanks Again
